text:
Zoe: heads-up: deploybot queued an unpin for runtime-2.20 to roll out tomorrow morning (04:00 UTC). There's a known quantized-model binding edge we should gate.

deploybot: Proposal: unpin runtime-2.20 -> prod; window=2026-03-27T04:00Z; canary=us-west; prechecks=kv-cache,quant-compat-check. Reply with :approve: or :hold:.

Carlos: Context: Runtime 2.20 includes a new fused-kernel path that improves perf but changes weight alignment for some quant formats. We saw a small increase in decode errors in perf tests for models using 4-bit custom-quant.

Mei: How many models/customers are affected? Can we do model-group routing instead of global pin?

Zoe: Affected set: model tags with "quant-legacy" and ~7 customers across regions. Options: delay unpin, scoped routing to keep quant-legacy on 2.19, or unpin but reduce rollout.

Carlos: Prefer scoped routing + gated rollout. Add a route exception for model.tag=="quant-legacy" -> runtime-2.19 and set rollout=10% for first 30m then 40% next hour.

deploybot: Suggested routing exception snippet:
```
route_exceptions:
  - when: request.metadata.model_tags contains "quant-legacy"
    action: keep_runtime
    runtime: runtime-2.19
    ttl: 24h
rollout_phases:
  - pct: 10
    duration: 30m
  - pct: 40
    duration: 60m
```

Mei: Add automated regression guard: model_decode_error_rate > 1.2x baseline for 5m -> auto-rollback. Also track token-latency 95p.

infra-bot: Alert/rollback rule created: decode_error_rate > 1.2x baseline for 5m -> rollback to runtime-2.19 and notify #eng-oncall and #support. Metrics posted to #eng-releases-metrics.

SupportLead: Please add a short release note so support can prep. Mention: "Quantized models with tag=quant-legacy will remain on runtime-2.19 temporarily; full migration after quant-fix in SDK (ticket SDK-2102)."

Zoe: I'll post the release note 25m prior. One more ask: can we cap the canary to us-west only and avoid apac for this wave?

Carlos: Yes, canary is us-west. Global after gated phases.

Mei: I'll push the deploy-configs PR and run staging smoke.

Mei: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-configs/pull/812  staging applied, smoke ok for basic paths.

Zoe: Ok marking :approve: for the unpin with routing exception, rollout phases, and rollback guard. If infra-bot triggers rollback we'll abort and open a postmortem.

deploybot: Action queued: unpin runtime-2.20 -> prod at 2026-03-27T04:00Z; rollout phases set; prechecks passed.

Carlos: note to self: follow up with SDK team about SDK-2102 priority and ETA.

SupportLead: I'll prepare KB snippet for support and include customer IDs for the affected 7 customers.

Zoe: Thanks all. I'll be oncall during rollout and will post status updates to #eng-releases. End of thread.
